notes: 1, 2 and 3 type again in every box. On a gig with more than one truck, the Which truck? box picks a truck when you press 1, 2, 3…, and those keys stayed switched on after it closed: every box after it (a case's details, a name, a count) wouldn't take those digits, and pressing one could put the earlier case into a truck. Now each box starts fresh, and a closed box's keys and clicks go with it.
